list: Official trophy list as published on PlayStation Network on 18 November 2026, cross-checked against Exophase, PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements. 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 hidden until earned. No online trophies: all 55 are single-player.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and name their sources beside each one. Where no source has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so plainly instead of guessing.
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
Exophase Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Everything is single-player, there is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so one playthrough covers it. PowerPyx rates the whole run 4 out of 10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it on the 100 percent completion checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks. Play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it unlocks once you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it unlocks once you start the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish the final mission of the story and it pops when the credits roll. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, but nothing story related can be missed, so just play the story through.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission as you play it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one the platinum really hangs on. After the story, the checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts. The thresholds are lenient, closer to 60 percent true completion: PowerPyx lists 200 of 277 base model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, and any 70 of 80 challenges, plus 100 optional missions (there are 200 to 300 in the game). Nothing on the checklist is missable and everything stays doable in free roam after the story. GTABase describes the same checklist as 35 tasks.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. PowerPyx breaks them down as 130 stunt jumps, 202 under the bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, and you can mix categories freely. Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find them on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. The 100 percent checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once each. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race or race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, Progress, Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you work on other trophies and the 100 percent checklist.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread over 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location, not every race. PowerPyx has a separate page listing all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in the game, so there is plenty of choice: pick the easiest ones first. A race win also counts toward one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge. PowerPyx notes the questline unlocks through that text, so check your phone after the mission.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in the game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and the fourth is found at arcade machines around the world. You must finish all levels of the game at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, which marks the questline in Belville. Finish all 5 of her quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving for shipwrecks: find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. He wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing is missable. Track him under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish all 5 of his quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers and Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count: PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile, Pete's Deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. All strands stay available after the story in free roam, and more counting strangers are still being found.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered: the Zorrusso plus the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Track them under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List, and scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is wanted. He is marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City, and the cars turn up most often in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Everything stays doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down, which unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as 2 meditations at the same location. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE, the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony; follow her, talk to her and choose Accept. That meditation adds 1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the others, so it is still unclear whether it is required. Do it anyway to be safe. The 100 percent checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County; Lucia cannot receive it. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy, and that Bret's 15 Target Decks are all needed for the 100 percent checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 collectible card set locations in a separate guide, so use a set map rather than wandering: you only need 3 full sets, not every card in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations in the world: hold Up and then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100: PowerPyx counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass. WAiNK scanning is also how you discover vehicles and check Randy's wishlist cars.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100 percent checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there. View and track them under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies; save this for late and then pick the easiest ones left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free roam with Jason and Lucia together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, build a 4 star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone on the map. PowerPyx recommends a fast sports motorcycle and cutting through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as an easy escape, since the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since large bank vault robberies always give a 4 star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle). Rob 3 robbery targets in a row, green icons on the map, while keeping the red and blue flashing wanted level the whole time; do not let it drop to nothing and do not let it rise to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. PowerPyx suggests the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and break the back room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and you may need a fourth shop if the police had not arrived at the first one yet.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The easiest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles at launch, and a busy road gives you dozens in minutes. The 100 percent checklist needs 200 of the 277 base model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past 100. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus activates with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar. Take down 5 enemies in a single use. PowerPyx advises buffing focus first with food, drinks or washing up, taking Adrenaline to extend it, lining up 5 enemies at a gang operation, and using an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 for accuracy. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier as you play and often pops naturally.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. PowerPyx says the easiest is the one at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. PowerPyx places the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, enter the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City as a good spot.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches bank vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard opens the vault, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani 10,000 dollars for security van tips, which mark vans with purple icons; you must have done his Payday Loans quests first. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4 star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: 5 for this trophy, all 8 for the 100 percent checklist, paying up to 205,000 dollars per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, PowerPyx says you can block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. PowerPyx recommends doing it by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. It comes naturally over a long playthrough, but a dedicated flight finishes it fast.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, Gangs. You only need 1 per gang for this trophy, but the 100 percent checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No source has confirmed how to earn this one yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned down the exact spot or step, so do not take any guess as fact. Check PowerPyx's guide again once more players have mapped the launch week.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Only that blue Banshee counts, not any other car. PowerPyx notes it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA 3, and the unlock pops with a slight delay after you drive away.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north east corner, and loot the safe in the north east hallway office, blowing it open with sticky bombs bought at an Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. It is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for what is left.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out at a fitness club, filtered on the map under Activities, or at home after the story. Always work out together with your partner (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training too, so you make double progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx advises turning on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Your profile moves through Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, which is permanent, so avoid excessive violence once you are warned. It comes passively from robberies and fights while you work on everything else; GTABase gives the same 500 action figure.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No source has confirmed how to earn this one yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is unconfirmed. Do not take the guess as fact: check PowerPyx's guide again once the launch week has pinned it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: No source has confirmed how to earn this one yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026, believed to be from a UFO questline, but that is unconfirmed. Do not take the guess as fact: check PowerPyx's guide again once the launch week has pinned it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No source has confirmed how to earn this one yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown as of 19 November 2026, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is unconfirmed. Do not take the guess as fact: check PowerPyx's guide again once the launch week has pinned it down.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide (not yet known, 19 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence: Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The 250,000 dollars counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to 205,000 dollars in a single robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. It comes naturally while you do robberies for the 100 percent checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of 100,000 dollars across all types of shops. PowerPyx says the fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, since those are the most expensive. The game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so normal shopping on the way to the platinum gets you most of the way there.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, costing 160,000 dollars in total. There are 4 more story-related garages that do not count. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone: buy them through the app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you. You need garages first, since each garage adds parking spots: see Little Boxes. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
